shortDescription: Manage system log timestamps and  terminal logging level on Comware 7 devices

options.name: level
options.description: Configure the minimum level of log information that the current terminal allows to output.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state for the interface configuration

options.name: timestamps
options.description: Configure the time stamp output format of log information sent to the console, monitoring terminal, log buffer and log file direction.
